title: LinkedIn Company Posts Scraper Input

companyUrls.title: LinkedIn company URLs
companyUrls.description: One or more public LinkedIn company page URLs, for example https://www.linkedin.com/company/shopify.

maxPosts.title: Maximum posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum number of post records to save across all company URLs.

startPage.title: Start page
startPage.description: the primary managed public-data route company-post pages are numbered from 1.

maxPagesPerCompany.title: Max pages per company
maxPagesPerCompany.description: the primary managed public-data route currently exposes up to 7 company-post pages because of LinkedIn public-page limits.

includeCompanyProfile.title: Include company profile
includeCompanyProfile.description: When the managed fallback route is available, attach public company metadata such as name, handle, followers, industry, logo, and website.

enrichPosts.title: Enrich post details
enrichPosts.description: Fetch each post detail with the managed fallback route when available to add engagement counts and author/comment previews. This costs one provider request per post.

includeRawData.title: Include raw response data
includeRawData.description: Include compact raw provider payloads for debugging and downstream custom parsing.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
